drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un hexagone dont les six sommets sont marqués d'un point, deux côtés opposés repassés en gras ; à l'intérieur, en tirets, ses trois diagonales et ses deux triangles inscrits.
drawings.kind: hexagon with its diagonals and its two inscribed triangles
drawings.notes: Left margin, beside « Soit H = (S, A, R) un hexagone combinatoire ». Six vertices placed once, each with a point; the six sides, four of them gone over heavily (top, upper right, bottom, lower left), the upper left and lower right ones lighter; inside, in loose short dashes, the two inscribed triangles, drawn between the same vertices so that they meet exactly (on the page several dashes are slightly curved). Nothing struck. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the three long diagonals drawn before are not on the page (the centre of the hexagon is empty) and are removed; the upper right and lower left sides are as heavy as the top and bottom ones; the top vertex moved 1 unit up. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, un polygone dessiné sur un cercle : le cercle porte alternativement quatre points et quatre croix ; l'arc qui va d'un point au suivant en passant par une croix est épaissi.
drawings.kind: polygon on a circle: vertices (points) and sides (crosses) alternating
drawings.notes: Right of the first lines. A freehand closed curve, wider than high and flattened at the top and lower left; on it, alternately, four full points and four crosses, at the places measured on the page; the arc from the upper point round the left to the lower left point, which passes through one cross, is gone over heavily, and a second heavy stroke runs straight from the upper point towards that cross. It is the picture of the duality between vertices and sides of a polygon (S and A) of which the page speaks. The note of the transcription says « un arc épaissi entre deux points »: the heavy arc runs between two consecutive points and carries the cross between them. The cross on the heavy arc is larger and has an extra stroke on the page. Nothing struck. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the earlier redraw was a circle with the marks at regular angles, up to 6 units off the page (upper right point, right cross); redrawn as a smooth curve through the eight measured marks. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
